description: Fetch a ticket with its full conversation: status, priority, category, contact, assignee, custom fields, SLA breaches and every update (messages, private notes, property changes, attachment links that expire in 5 minutes). HappyFox: GET /api/1.1/json/ticket/<ticket_number>/.

show_cf_changes.description: Include the history of custom-field changes in the updates.

ticket_number.description: The ticket NUMBER (the `id` field, e.g. 3 for #DC00000003) — not the prefixed display id.

name: happyfox_get_ticket
title: Get one ticket
